integrity.bibliographic_risk: Specialized parity-selective dephasing literature not indexed by available searches might contain equivalent formulas.
integrity.mathematical_status: analytical proof with direct finite-dimensional numerical crosschecks

scientific_limitations: Finite hypercubes only, with the long-time limit taken before increasing dimension.
The monitoring is independent rank-one site dephasing at every even vertex, with arbitrary strictly positive rates; collective parity measurements are different.
The theorem assumes an unweighted nearest-neighbor hypercube Hamiltonian with a nonzero real hopping scale and no onsite energies or sinks.
No uniform-in-dimension relaxation-rate bound is asserted.
title: Parity-protected polynomial return on half-dephased quantum hypercubes
